claims.claim: American used Nikon D750 Body, clean and pure as new, working perfectly.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show Nikon-branded camera/lens packaging and a camera with a long lens, but no readable model (D750) and no functional test evidence.

claims.claim: We have the model is D850.
claims.evidence: Witness report states exact camera model/series is not readable from the photos; no D850 text is confirmed.

risks.risk: Wrong camera model (seller says D750 and also says D850), which changes value and compatibility of accessories.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model text (e.g., 'D750' or 'D850') and the lens model name/number on the lens barrel, plus the box label showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR body with unknown model and unknown completeness; treat as not guaranteed to match the claimed model.

risks.risk: Not a complete kit (battery/charger/strap/hood/cables may be missing).
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing every included item (battery, charger, cables, strap, lens hood, manuals completeness) with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only or incomplete kit (worst-case missing common accessories).

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches/dents, lens haze/fungus, sensor dust) that packaging photos cannot reveal.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: (1) lens front element at an angle for haze/fungus, (2) lens rear element, (3) camera screen and body corners, (4) a test shot of a blank wall/sky to reveal sensor dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and possible need for cleaning/repair.

risks.risk: Working status not proven (autofocus, zoom, buttons, ports, viewfinder/EVF, stabilization).
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and a quick photo/video recording test; include a shot showing focus lock.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested; assume potential faults until proven.

risks.risk: Authenticity/receipt/warranty uncertainty (counterfeit or non-original parts possible).
risks.proof: Photos of serial number plate on the body and lens, plus the box label/serial match; if available, receipt/warranty card photo.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera body showing the exact model name (D750 or D850) and serial number.
Clear photo of the lens model text on the lens barrel (and whether it’s the lens included in the box).
A full inventory photo of everything inside the box (battery, charger, strap, cables, lens hood, manuals) with labels visible.
Short video test: power on, menu, autofocus on a moving subject, and a sample photo/video playback.
Close-up photos of lens front/rear elements and body condition (corners, screen, ports).
Photo of box label/serial number and any receipt/warranty documentation if present.
response.reason: The witness confirms Nikon packaging and a Nikon camera/lens setup, but the exact model and working/condition details needed to price confidently are not readable or test-proven in the report. Proof is required to resolve model mismatch and completeness/condition.
